segments.sn1.53:1.1: “Kiṃsu pavasato [pathavato (pī. ka.)] mittaṃ, kiṃsu mittaṃ sake ghare;
segments.sn1.53:1.3: Kiṃ mittaṃ atthajātassa, kiṃ mittaṃ samparāyikan”ti.
segments.sn1.53:2.1: “Sattho pavasato mittaṃ, mātā mittaṃ sake ghare;

lines: Tatiye satthoti saddhiṃcaro, jaṅghasattho vā sakaṭasattho vā.
Mittanti roge uppanne pāṭaṅkiyā vā aññena vā yānena haritvā khemantasampāpanena mittaṃ.
Tathārūpe roge jāte puttabhariyādayo jigucchanti, mātā pana asucimpi candanaṃ viya maññati.
Sahāyo atthajātassāti uppannakiccassa yo taṃ kiccaṃ vahati nittharati, so kiccesu saha ayanabhāvena sahāyo mittaṃ, surāpānādisahāyā pana na mittā.
Saha atthena vattatīti sattho, bhaṇḍamūlaṃ gahetvā vāṇijjavasena desantarādīsu vicaraṇakajanasamūho.
Yathā asaṇṭhitānaṃ saṇṭhāpanavasena pavasato purisassa bhogabyasane nāthatā, evaṃ puttasinehavasena puttassa mātuyā antogehe nāthatāti vuttaṃ “mātā mittaṃ sake ghare”ti.
